en: Even I think it's a strange habit I've
fallen into, I must admit.
I shave the wood with a plane like this and
make wheels, but that requires, beforehand,
some proper planning, you see.
So, "I must be proper, I must be proper,"
I kept thinking, and somehow,
my way of speaking ended up like this too.
The way I speak
might sound odd in a village like this
perhaps.
But in a city bigger than this one,
where bonds between people are weaker,
I think everyone speaks like this.
Here, everyone more or less knows everyone,
so a visitor from elsewhere, like you,
is a rare sight.
So are people who speak as I do,
mind you.
Ah, but you, too, already
seem to know quite a lot of people here.
If you're not used to it, like me,
note: 'like me' read as 'for someone unused to it, as I am'

en: Ah, my apologies,
Yes, it's better when you call me that,
it feels more natural.
It's rare for someone in this village
to speak so very politely.
Around here, that may be so.
I make wheels, but
for something like that,
careful planning is needed beforehand.
So I resolved to be proper in everything...
and before I knew it,
even my speech had ended up like this.
If you ever go to the city,
it might be a good idea to
speak this way yourself.
You are my lord. Command me.

en: God is with you.
Pray, and love.
I am Ramon, the priest.
I came here on assignment, so
I do not know this place well, but
you seem to be deeply rooted in this land.
Have you come to pray again?
I am Ramon, the priest.
I never forget anyone who has visited the church once.
Please come again.
This church turns away no one who comes.

a self-styled vampire hunter.
A flame is reflected in your eyes,
and beyond it I see a dried-up lake.
Like me, you seem to have taken a wrong path
